description:
Explain why two register records are, or are not, the same company: today's decision with reason codes and evidence, stored decisions, links, and whether they share one Fuentio entity.
Use it after resolve_company or lookup_company when you must justify a match or a rejection. Don't use it to find companies: call resolve_company.
Inputs: left and right, Fuentio record IDs (e.g. 'FR-SIREN-441639465', 'FR-LEI-969500F7JLTX36OUI695').
Returns: same_entity, summary, decision (status, band, reasons), stored_decisions, links, uncertainty.
Limits: 1 unit. Read-only.
name: explain_match
title: Why two records are (or aren't) the same company
